qa_pairs.question: Which screw size requires the highest torque when mounting the clutch housing to crankcase?
qa_pairs.answer: M12 screws require the highest torque at 86 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M8 and M10 screws for clutch housing attachment?
qa_pairs.answer: The difference is 24 Nm (M10 at 51 Nm minus M8 at 27 Nm)
